description: This is a Java JUnit test class for testing the JobStarter component of the Fineract project, specifically testing job parameter retrieval and job execution scenarios within the job scheduling framework.

classes.name: JobStarterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the JobStarter component, including methods for testing parameter retrieval and job execution workflows.

methods.name: getJobParameterTest
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job parameters from the repository for a scheduled job detail.

methods.name: provideCustomJobParameters
methods.description: Tests the provision of custom job parameters via JobParameterProvider implementations.

methods.name: runWithComplete
methods.description: Tests the scenario where a job execution completes successfully.

methods.name: runWithFailed
methods.description: Tests the scenario where a job execution fails with different failure statuses, ensuring proper exception handling.
